description: Compose a personalized Loom-style video from a Drive-hosted intro audio track and a screenshot of the lead's website; upload the result to Drive. Stage 2 of the Loom outreach pipeline: consumes the audio produced by personalized-loom-outreach-poc and returns video_drive_file_id.

notes: Stage 2 of the Loom outreach pipeline; consumes the audio produced by personalized-loom-outreach-poc.

Drive I/O is direct HTTP to the Google Drive REST API; the host injects the tenant Google OAuth token (http.credentials), the same way the google-drive tool authenticates. tool-invoke is a deny-all stub in the runtime.
The screenshot service MUST return JPEG -- the bundled ffmpeg has no PNG decoder.
